summary: derekchiang 与 lightclient 讨论后提交 EIP-8141 的 EOA 支持：VERIFY frame 的目标没有代码时，直接按 ECDSA 签名验证，EOA 无需部署合约即可使用 frame 交易。EIP-8141 首次头号提案专场举行。dcrapis 提交 Agentic Commerce ERC，定义基于任务的托管支付。

items.topic: 原生 AA：EIP-8141 支持 EOA
items.title: EIP-8141：加入 EOA 支持
items.note: （derekchiang）提交：若 frame 处于 VERIFY 模式且 frame.target 没有代码，把 frame.data 读作 (scope, v, r, s) 并验证其为有效签名。
items.note_en: (derekchiang), submitted: if a frame is in VERIFY mode and frame.target has no code, frame.data is read as (scope, v, r, s) and checked as a valid signature.

items.note: （dcrapis）提交；Magicians 讨论帖 ERC-8183 04:49：基于任务的托管，客户方为任务注资，服务方提交成果，单一评估方确认完成或拒绝，可选钩子与 ERC-8004 信誉和 ERC-2771 无 gas 流程组合。

summary_en: After discussion with lightclient, derekchiang submitted EOA support for EIP-8141: when a VERIFY frame's target has no code, its data is verified as an ECDSA signature, so EOAs can use frame transactions without deploying a contract. The first EIP-8141 headliner breakout took place. dcrapis submitted the Agentic Commerce ERC, defining job based escrow.
